sentences.en: Thanks for coming everyone
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家的到来。

sentences.en: OK, so this meeting is for new staff and staff who haven't been involved with our volunteering projects yet
sentences.zh: 好的，本次会议面向新员工以及尚未参与过我们志愿项目的老员工。

sentences.en: So basically, the idea is that we allow staff to give up some of their work time to help on various charity projects to benefit the local community
sentences.zh: 基本理念是，我们允许员工抽出部分工作时间，参与各类慈善项目，以造福本地社区。

sentences.en: We've been doing this for the last five years and it's been very successful
sentences.zh: 过去五年来，我们一直开展这项活动，且成效显著。

sentences.en: a Participating doesn't necessarily involve a huge time commitment
sentences.zh: a 参与并不一定需要投入大量时间。

sentences.en: The company will pay for eight hours of your time
sentences.zh: 公司会为每位员工支付八小时的志愿服务时间费用。

sentences.en: That can be used over one or two days all at once, or spread over
sentences.zh: 这八小时可集中使用于一至两天，也可分散使用。

sentences.en: several months throughout the year
sentences.zh: 在全年数月内分次使用。

sentences.en: There are some staff who enjoy volunteering so much they also give up their own free time for a couple of hours every week
sentences.zh: 有些员工非常热衷志愿服务，甚至每周额外自愿贡献两小时个人空闲时间。

sentences.en: It's completely up to you
sentences.zh: 完全由您自行决定。

sentences.en: Obviously, many people will have family commitments and aren't as available as other members of staff
sentences.zh: 显然，许多人有家庭责任，因此可支配时间不如其他同事充裕。

sentences.en: Feedback from staff has been overwhelmingly positive
sentences.zh: 员工反馈总体极为积极。

sentences.en: Because they felt they were doing something really useful. nearly everyone agreed that volunteering made them feel more motivated at work
sentences.zh: 因为他们感到自己正在做真正有意义的事情，几乎所有人都认同志愿服务提升了他们在工作中的积极性。

sentences.en: They also liked building relationships with the people in the local community and felt valued by them
sentences.zh: 他们也喜欢与本地社区居民建立联系，并感受到对方的认可与重视。

sentences.en: One or two people also said it was a good thing to have on their CVs
sentences.zh: 一两位员工还表示，志愿服务经历对丰富个人简历很有帮助。

sentences.en: One particularly successful project last year was the Get Working Project
sentences.zh: 去年一个特别成功的项目是“重返职场”项目。

sentences.en: This was aimed at helping unemployed people in the area get back to work
sentences.zh: 该项目旨在帮助本地区失业人员重新就业。

sentences.en: Our staff were able to help them improve their telephone skills, such as writing down messages and speaking with confidence to potential customers, which they had found quite difficult
sentences.zh: 我们的员工协助他们提升电话沟通技能，例如准确记录留言、自信地与潜在客户通话——这些正是他们此前感到颇为困难的方面。

sentences.en: This iS something many employers look for in job applicants - and something we all do without even thinking about, every day at work
sentences.zh: 这是许多雇主在招聘时看重的能力，也是我们在日常工作中不假思索便能完成的事情。

sentences.en: We've got an exciting new project starting this year
sentences.zh: ：今年我们将启动一个令人振奋的新项目。

sentences.en: Up until now, we've mainly focused on projects to do with education and training
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，我们的项目主要聚焦于教育与培训领域。

sentences.en: And we'll continue with our reading project in schools and our work with local charities
sentences.zh: 我们将继续开展校园阅读项目以及与本地慈善机构的合作。

sentences.en: But we've also agreed to help out on a conservation project in Redfern Park
sentences.zh: 但我们也已同意参与雷德芬公园的环保项目。

sentences.en: So f any of you fancy being outside and getting your hands dirty, this is the project for you
sentences.zh: 所以，如果您喜欢户外活动并乐于亲自动手，这个项目正适合您。

sentences.en: I also want to mention the annual Digital Inclusion Day, which is coming up next month
sentences.zh: 我还想提一下下月即将举行的年度‘数字包容日’活动。

sentences.en: The aim of this is to help older people keep up with technology
sentences.zh: 该活动旨在帮助老年人跟上科技发展的步伐。

sentences.en: And this year, instead of hosting
sentences.zh: 而今年，我们不再于公司自有培训设施内举办该活动。

sentences.en: the event in our own training facility, we're using the ICT suite at Hill College, as it can hold far more people
sentences.zh: 而是改用希尔学院的信息通信技术（ICT）教室，因其容量远大于我方场地。

sentences.en: We've invited over 60 people from the Silver Age Community Centre to take part, so we'll need a lot of volunteers to help with this event
sentences.zh: 我们已邀请银龄社区中心六十多位人士参与，因此本次活动亟需大量志愿者协助。

sentences.en: If you're interested in taking part, please go to the volunteering section of our website and complete the relevant form
sentences.zh: 若您有意参加，请访问公司网站的志愿服务板块并填写相应表格。

sentences.en: We won't be providing any training for this but you'll be paired with an experienced volunteer if you've never done it before
sentences.zh: 本次活动不提供专门培训，但若您此前从未参与过，我们将为您安排一位经验丰富的志愿者搭档。

sentences.en: By the way, don't forget to tell your manager about any volunteering activities you decide to do
sentences.zh: 顺便提醒一下，请务必向您的主管告知您所决定参与的任何志愿服务活动。

sentences.en: The participants on the Digital Inclusion Day really benefited
sentences.zh: ‘数字包容日’的参与者确实获益良多。

sentences.en: The majority were in their seventies, though some were younger and a few were even in their nineties!
sentences.zh: 参与者多数年逾七十，虽有部分较年轻，亦有少数已近百岁！

sentences.en: Quite a few owned both a computer and a mobile phone, but these tended to be outdated models
sentences.zh: 相当一部分人同时拥有电脑和手机，但这些设备往往型号陈旧。

sentences.en: They generally knew how to do simple things, like send texts, but weren't aware of recent developments in mobile phone technology
sentences.zh: 他们通常仅掌握发送短信等基础操作，却对手机技术的最新发展知之甚少。

sentences.en: A few were keen to learn but most were quite dismissive at first - they couldn't see the point of updating their skills
sentences.zh: 少数人热切希望学习，但大多数人起初态度冷淡——他们看不到更新自身技能的意义。

sentences.en: But that soon changed
sentences.zh: 但这种情况很快发生了改变。

sentences.en: The feedback was very positive
sentences.zh: 反馈意见非常积极。

sentences.en: The really encouraging thing was that participants all said they felt much more confident about using social media to keep in touch with their grandchildren, who prefer this form of communication to phoning or sending emails
sentences.zh: 尤为鼓舞人心的是，所有参与者均表示，他们现在使用社交媒体与孙辈保持联系时信心大增；而孙辈们恰恰更偏好这种沟通方式，而非打电话或发电子邮件。

sentences.en: A lot of them also said playing online games would help them make new friends and keep their brains active
sentences.zh: 很多人还表示，玩在线游戏有助于他们结交新朋友并保持大脑活跃。

sentences.en: They weren't that impressed with being able to order their groceries online, as they liked going out to the shops, but some said it would come in handy if they were ill or the weather was really bad
sentences.zh: 他们对能够在网上订购杂货并不怎么感兴趣，因为他们喜欢出门去商店购物，但有些人表示，如果生病了或天气非常糟糕，这会派上用场。

sentences.en: One thing they asked about was using tablets for things like reading newspapers - some people had been given tablets as presents but had never used them, sO that's something we'll make sure we include this time
sentences.zh: 他们询问的一个问题是使用平板电脑阅读报纸等事项——有些人曾收到过作为礼物的平板电脑，却从未使用过，因此这次我们一定会将这一内容纳入其中……
